banner.title: EQUIPPING THE CHARACTER AND TABLE 47, printed capture pp. 76-78 - the OA equipment round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture alone for this range (the settling authority): the first Mistral-OCR capture session is unavailable above p. 33, so the cross-capture agreement check is impossible. The equipping prose pins from capture p. 76 (printed p. 38) and the full Table 47 from capture pp. 77-78 (printed pp. 39-40); the T47 gap box label reads capture pp. 78-84 - the label is preserved byte-exact in the flip. The printed table carries TEN sections - the eight cost lists the box names plus the ARMOR and ARMS lists that ride the same table; all ten pin this round as 256 rows, each a cost-unit-star triple (the unit code 1 fen, 2 yuan, 3 tael, 4 ch'ien per the R636 T43 doctrine; the star flags pin the printed asterisks - the ten armor-piece rows, the chijiriki, the five ninja-preferred misc rows). No contested cells detected within the single source. OCR normalizations: the Kyoketsu-shogi "(biaded rope)" reads as bladed rope and the stray mid-table separator row after it is an OCR artifact pinning nothing. The Weapons chapter prose with Tables 48-49 (capture pp. 79-80) is deliberately left for the next round

bools.name: dgzEquipAfterCreation
bools.comment: equipping prose (capture p. 76): after a character is created it is important to equip him - without equipment the character is at a great disadvantage

bools.name: dgzEquipAdventuringReason
bools.comment: equipping prose (capture p. 76): initially the character is not likely to get everything he wants - not enough money - which is not bad, since it provides the perfect reason to adventure

bools.name: dgzEquipEstablishedPrices
bools.comment: equipping prose (capture p. 76): the prices given are figured using established currency

bools.name: dgzEquipBarterPurchase
bools.comment: equipping prose (capture p. 76): characters can also purchase the equipment through barter units, using the barter-unit values already given

bools.name: dgzEquipIncompleteList
bools.comment: equipping prose (capture p. 76): the equipment list is by no means complete - it covers the items most frequently used, and the DM can freely add items if needed

bools.name: dgzEquipPriceChange
bools.comment: equipping prose (capture p. 76): the DM can change the price of any item for sound campaign reasons - scarcity, quality of workmanship

bools.name: dgzEquipAvailability
bools.comment: equipping prose (capture p. 76): the DM can rule items unavailable in areas of Kara-Tur - such items obviously cannot be purchased

bools.name: dgzT47ArmorPieceNote
bools.comment: T47 armor footnote (capture p. 77): the asterisk marks an armor piece, not a complete suit

bools.name: dgzT47NinjaPrefNote
bools.comment: T47 misc footnote (capture p. 78): the asterisked items are preferred by ninja
